changelog: Cards turn white in light mode: `surfaceRaised` becomes the page's white, and the `surface` shadow lifts them, a hairline ring at 4 % then two soft layers (0 2 8 at 6 %, 0 8 24 at 4 %), instead of the beige `#F4F3EF` and its faint shadow. `control` keeps the beige: inputs, pills, chips and received bubbles. Six contrast pairs now cover `control` (text, muted text, link, accent, selection, focus ring). Dark mode does not change. Includes 0.2.6: Under `MaterialApp`, a screen placed outside a `Material` (as `home`, or pushed in a `MaterialPageRoute`) no longer has every text underlined twice in yellow: `FlScope` sets text without decoration below it. Rendering unchanged elsewhere. Includes 0.2.5: Installs `LICENSE` at the root of the items (`lib/ui/fliin/LICENSE`): Fliin's MIT license, the notices of the third parties the copied files derive from, and the full text of their licenses. Rendering unchanged. Includes 0.2.4: Buttons wider than tall: `size.buttonPaddingSm`, `buttonPaddingMd` and `buttonPaddingLg` go from 14, 16 and 20 to 20, 24 and 28 (the button, the button group, the post actions), about 1.7 times the vertical padding. Includes 0.2.3: three springs: `pop` (an entrance that overshoots by about 20%: badge, heart, toast icon), `roll` (the wheel of a digit, about 450 ms) and `shake` (the shake of a refusal, three oscillations). `FlPop` makes a child appear with a bounce (delay, starting scale, `replay` to bounce without disappearing) and keeps it on exit; `FlShake` shakes it once sideways, towards the start of the line; `FlRollingText` rolls the digits of a written number, up when it grows, down when it shrinks. All three reduce to a fade or to nothing under reduced motion, and render the child intact at rest. Rendering unchanged. Includes 0.2.2: light `overlay` shadow: three layers (0 2 8 at 6%, 0 −6 12 at 3%, 0 14 28 at 8% black) instead of 0 8 24 at 12%. `flOverlayOutline`: the outline of a floating panel, `border` in dark mode, transparent in light mode. `FlPopupContent`: the popover grows from 0.92 to 1 from the anchor side (its `side` gives the origin) and exits towards 0.96; the dialog settles from 1.04 to 1 and exits towards 0.96. Accent selection: `selected` and `onSelected` switch to the accent and white; white shadowed `field` (`shadow.field`, the three layers of `--field-shadow`), white `segment` on the `control` track. New `link` role: text written in accent on a surface (back and bar actions, link), the focus ring strokes, `#1D4ED8` in light mode and `#7AA7FF` in dark mode, where `selected` (`#3B63F6`) only has 3.93:1 on the page; three text contrast pairs (`surface`, `surfaceRaised`, `surfaceOverlay`). Includes 0.2.1: adds `size.hoverBrightness` (0.92): the brightness of a filled button on hover, the canvas `filter: brightness(.92)`. Disabled at 50% (`size.disabledOpacity`), like every disabled state of the Izydesk canvas, instead of 40%. `FlFocusRing` takes an optional `gap`: a field's ring follows its outline, like Izydesk's `0 0 0 2px`. `thumb` shadow (0 1 3 at 18% and 0 0 1 at 20% black), which lifts the switch and slider thumb off its track, like the canvas. The dark scrim (`color.dark.scrim`) is Izydesk's black at 55%, instead of the page background at 55%, which dimmed nothing on the dark page. Includes 0.2.0: new Izydesk look: tokens from the Izydesk design system, blue accent: warm grays, `selected` and `onSelected` roles for every checked or chosen state, `glow` and `dangerGlow` halos, no shadow on what does not float, radii 8, 12, 20 and pill, pill button, compact control at 44, disabled at 40%, typography without weight 700. The shipped theme passes AA without exception. The `scrim` carries its opacity; selection handles switch to `selected`. Presets move to version `b`. Also includes 0.1.3: size.surfaceBorder: the stroke of a surface (0 by default), which the “flat cards” preset sets to the size.border thickness. Version b presets also own size.border, size.surfaceBorder, the size and line height of each typography.scale role (not the weight or the tracking), motion.duration and the stiffness of springs: a hand edit under these paths is overwritten and reported. Rendering unchanged under the shipped theme. Light `surface` shadow: three layers (0 2 4 at 4%, 0 1 2 at 6%, 0 0 1 at 6%); still nothing in dark mode. FlRollingText only rolls digits that change: a value coming out of a mask without digits, or the same digits dressed differently (isolated for Arabic), shows at once.
